profile.description: MMAudio generates synchronized audio given text and/or video inputs. Send a prompt to generate an audio corresponding to it, or send a video with the prompt to generate audio for it. Use `--duration` to set the duration of the generated audio, or the portion of the video to add an audio to (WARNING: for adding audio to videos, please set the duration properly to avoid adding audio to only a portion of the video or being overcharged). Send a negative prompt with `--negative_prompt` to refine the generation.
